prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic natural lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman walking toward camera on a peaceful countryside road at golden hour.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long straight light-brown hair, warm natural skin, and a soft gentle smile. She walks naturally toward camera wearing a simple black T-shirt, blue denim jeans, and black canvas sneakers with white laces.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level full-body framing with the subject centered on a quiet paved country road. Include green trees, open fields, warm backlit edges, and a soft blue sky with light clouds.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm late-afternoon sunlight from the side, soft shadows, golden glow, peaceful fresh natural mood, realistic outdoor texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic natural lifestyle photography, vertical full-body composition, sharp subject, gentle background depth, realistic hair, denim, road, trees, and sunlight.
